dl_grandmothers_memory.name: The Grandmother's Memory
dl_grandmothers_memory.desc: A pale light caught in a fold of ghost-hide. It remembers a morning a very long time ago.

dl_dawn_mote.name: Dawn-Pale Mote
dl_dawn_mote.desc: A speck of old morning that a herd-spirit carried in its bones.

dl_ysmoor_sunstone.name: Ysmoor's Sunstone
dl_ysmoor_sunstone.desc: A dull amber stone. Held up, it's warm on the side facing east, wherever east is.

dl_attuned_sunstone.name: Attuned Sunstone
dl_attuned_sunstone.desc: Ysmoor's Sunstone, woken by Evander's reading. A faint sunrise moves inside it.

dl_last_dawn_lamp.name: The Last Dawn-Lamp
dl_last_dawn_lamp.desc: A brass lamp, cold and black inside. Its wick was lit from the Dawn-Tusk's own fire.

dl_lit_dawn_lamp.name: The Dawn-Lamp, Relit
dl_lit_dawn_lamp.desc: Solenne relit it from the Lampward's oldest flame. It burns gold, and the dark leans away from it.

dl_dawnspear_head.name: The Dawnspear's Head
dl_dawnspear_head.desc: A spearhead of white stone, broken from the Dawn-Tusk's champion's hand on Lastwalk.

dl_hallowed_spearhead.name: Hallowed Dawnspear Head
dl_hallowed_spearhead.desc: The Dawnspear's head, hallowed by Wilhelmina. It points north whatever way you hold it.

dl_ember_of_first_light.name: The Ember of First Light
dl_ember_of_first_light.desc: The first morning's last coal, taken back from the Dimming. Too bright to look at; warm as a held hand.

dl_pendant_of_the_last_dawn.name: Pendant of the Last Dawn
dl_pendant_of_the_last_dawn.desc: The Dawn-Tusk's thanks: a sliver of the first morning on a gold chain.

dr_dimmed_ash.name: Dimmed Ash
dr_dimmed_ash.desc: What light leaves when something eats it.

dr_sunstone_chip.name: Sunstone Chip
dr_sunstone_chip.desc: Chipped from a dawn-sentinel; still faintly warm.

dr_gilded_feather.name: Gilded Feather
dr_gilded_feather.desc: A dawnwing's flight feather, gold at the tip.

dr_gilded_fleece.name: Gilded Fleece
dr_gilded_fleece.desc: Wool that holds the morning; warm in any weather.

dr_sunwyrm_scale.name: Sunwyrm Scale
dr_sunwyrm_scale.desc: A sunwyrm's scale, amber and hard as bronze.

dr_goldmaw_fang.name: Goldmaw's Fang
dr_goldmaw_fang.desc: A fang longer than a hand, gold at the root.

dr_abbots_prayer_beads.name: Hollow Abbot's Prayer Beads
dr_abbots_prayer_beads.desc: Sunstone beads gone dull, all but one.

dr_heart_of_the_dimming.name: Heart of the Dimming
dr_heart_of_the_dimming.desc: A ring of black glass with nothing at all inside it. Your hand looks dimmer wearing it.
